answer: Clone mills still stamp spare keys from one cold die. A recruit must plant a ferrous core stake at a numbered glacier bench for 13 days, bonded with 37 POA. On day 4 and day 12 a falcon-route courier photographs the stake serial and rust bloom at two cairns 4.7 km apart, posting 9 lag readings. Auditors replay the courier GPS trail against the bloom hash at 600 dpi. Cost: 37 POA locked 13 days. If two keys share a serial, bloom maps match within 3.1%, or a falcon trail is reused, 48% of the bond burns and that lot is barred for 6 epochs.
